sv.title: Firades som Danmarks äldsta – hade mörkt förflutet
sv.summary: Hon har under hösten firats som den äldsta personen i Danmarks historia. Men av uppmärksamheten följde avslöjanden från en mörkare del av hennes liv.

en.title: Celebrated as Denmark's Oldest – Had a Dark Past
en.summary: She was celebrated this autumn as the oldest person in Danish history. But the attention was followed by revelations from a darker part of her life.
